stem.text: Chromosome telomeres are essential for DNA replication and are **not** completely replaced during mitosis.
Substance X completely replaces telomeres during mitosis.
What will be the effect of growing cells with and without substance X?

A.text: cells divide continually; cell division eventually slows and stops

B.text: cells divide more rapidly; cells divide continually

C.text: cell division eventually slows and stops; cell division stops immediately

D.text: cell division stops immediately; cells divide continually

A: cell division eventually slows and stops
C: cell division eventually slows and stops
